claim_1.claim: Hemagglutination Inhibition and Neutralizing Antibody Titer Assay analysis of serum from vaccinated individuals showed a correlation between the transcriptional and antibody responses, with 20 genes exhibiting significant genotype-expression association and correlation between transcriptional and antibody responses compared to baseline.

sources.section: Integration of genotype, expression, and antibody titer data identifies 20 genes with the strongest evidence for genetic variation influencing the humoral immune response to influenza vaccination
sources.quote: We imposed an additional selection threshold based on this correlation, and identified 20 genes that show evidence of significant genotype-expression association (genotype effect p<5 × 10 −8 ), a significant correlation between the transcriptional and antibody responses (expression-antibody effect p<0.05), and either a transcriptional response to the vaccine (day effect p<0.01) or evidence of a change in the magnitude of the genetic effect after vaccination (top 1% of the delta-R g 2 distribution) in the two independent cohorts.

groups.assay_method: Hemagglutination Inhibition and Neutralizing Antibody Titer Assay
